name: Blocking Overlay
description: A full-surface overlay with a spinner that blocks interaction with the wrapped content during async work.

anatomy.description: Relative container around the protected content; sets aria-busy while the overlay is visible.
Full-surface layer that blocks pointer interaction and traps Tab while shown.
Centered spinner in a role="status" region labeled by the label prop.

dos: Use it when concurrent edits would corrupt state, such as during a bulk save.
Keep the label specific to the work in progress, such as "Saving changes".
donts: Don't block the whole page for one control's work; use a Button loading state instead.
Don't leave the overlay visible without a failure or timeout path.

examples.title: Always-on overlay
examples.description: The overlay covering placeholder content while visible.

examples.title: Triggered by work
examples.description: A simulated save that shows and hides the overlay around real async work.

guidance.useWhen: An in-flight operation must not be interrupted by further edits, such as a form save or a bulk action.
guidance.avoidWhen: The content can remain interactive or a small inline spinner is enough; use Spinner or LoadingState instead.
guidance.behavior: While visible it covers the wrapped content, sets aria-busy, moves focus into the overlay, and traps Tab until hidden.
guidance.responsive: Fills its positioned container at any size; keep the container relative and full-width on small screens.

keyboard.action: Cycles focus within the overlay; the blocked content is unreachable.
Cycles focus within the overlay in reverse.

notes: The wrapper exposes aria-busy while the overlay is visible.
The overlay is a role="status" region labeled by the label prop, and focus is restored to the previously focused element when it hides.

props.description: Shows the overlay and blocks interaction with the wrapped content while true.
props.name: visible

props.description: Accessible label announced while the overlay is visible; also rendered under the spinner.
props.name: label
